audit.whatIsWrong: The page gives Jayce an 'E hop' and an 'Acceleration Gate dash', and calls his poke a 'hammer-Q gate combo'.
audit.why: Riot text: Acceleration Gate is the Cannon-stance E — it is a speed gate for allies passing through and it empowers a Shock Blast fired through it. It is not a dash. Hammer-stance E is Thundering Blow, a knockback. The only mobility in the kit is To the Skies! (hammer Q leap) and Hextech Capacitor's move-speed burst on a stance swap, which is also the auto reset that opens his combo. Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and Acceleration Gate 20s.
audit.corrected: mid, spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] rewritten onto the real mechanics; dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[0].d carry the 16s and 20s; dontsFull[1].d states the stance-swap reset tell.

edits.before: Level 6 is where I flip it. Depth Charge homes — his Acceleration Gate dash and E hop don't dodge it, so I R him, the knock-up lands, then I Q-pull into passive root, E slow, and he physically cannot kite out of the chain. His first-item poke spike at 4-5 still hurts and he'll try to zone me off the wave, so I bait his combo, then engage the instant his Q gate is on cooldown. One clean R is a kill on a squishy with no defensive layer.
